sites.title: Websites
sites.description: Uptime, SSL certificates and domains for your clients' websites. Checked every 5 minutes; partners get an alert if something fails.
sites.readOnly: Read only: adding or changing websites is up to a partner.

filters.label: Filter websites
filters.search: Search by name, domain or client
filters.noResultsBody: Try another name or clear the filters.
filters.noProblemsBody: No website is down, slow or about to expire.

empty.title: Monitor your clients' websites
empty.body: Add the websites you host and GNERAI OS will check them every 5 minutes: if one goes down, or its SSL certificate or domain is about to expire, the partners get an alert.
empty.readOnly: No websites yet. A partner adds them.

actions.paused: {name} paused: it's no longer checked and won't alert.
actions.deleteBody: It stops being monitored and its checks are deleted. To stop the alerts for a while, pause it instead.

sheet.description: Checked every 5 minutes: whether it responds, how long it takes and when its SSL certificate expires.
sheet.urlHint: The website's address; without https:// works too.
sheet.label: Name
sheet.domainHint: The date from the registrar: we'll warn you before it expires.
sheet.hostedByUsHint: It's on our server (otherwise we only monitor it).
sheet.activeHint: While paused it isn't checked and doesn't alert.
sheet.notesPlaceholder: Where it's hosted, who manages the domain…
sheet.created: Website added: we're checking it right now.

bulk.title: Add several websites
bulk.description: Paste the domains, one per line. Websites already monitored are skipped.
bulk.label: Websites
bulk.hint: One per line (up to {max}). Without https:// works too; lines starting with # are ignored.
bulk.matchClientsHint: If the website matches the one on a client's record.
bulk.clientHint: If they all belong to the same client.
bulk.previewSummary: {add, plural, other {# new}} · {known, plural, other {# already monitored}} · {invalid, plural, other {# invalid}}
bulk.added: {count, plural, =0 {No new websites} one {# website added} other {# websites added}}
bulk.skipped: {count, plural, one {# was already monitored.} other {# were already monitored.}}

thresholds.title: Alert thresholds
thresholds.description: When to alert the partners. They apply to every website in the organization.

down_after_failures.label: Failures in a row to alert
down_after_failures.hint: A one-off failure doesn't alert: how many in a row count as down ({min}–{max}).

incidents.title: Downtime
incidents.summary: {count, plural, one {# incident} other {# incidents}} in 7 days{blips, plural, =0 {} one { · # one-off failure} other { · # one-off failures}}
incidents.empty: No downtime in the last 7 days.
incidents.emptyWithBlips: No downtime in 7 days ({count, plural, one {# one-off failure} other {# one-off failures}}, unconfirmed).
incidents.failures: {count, plural, one {# failed check} other {# failed checks}}

chart.title: Last 7 days
chart.description: Hourly: how long it took to respond and the failures.
chart.tableCaption: Checks per hour over the last 7 days
chart.empty: No checks in the last 7 days yet.

client.title: Websites
client.empty: We don't monitor any website for this client.
client.allGood: {count, plural, one {# website, all good} other {# websites, all good}}

notFound.title: This website doesn't exist
notFound.body: It may have been removed, or the link isn't right.

errors.invalidUrl: That URL isn't valid: it must be an https website.

validation.url: Not a valid website: type a domain (e.g. clinicamarblau.com).
